text:
rachel_fin: FYI invoice showed an unexpected egress line item for October — INV-2024-234 has a $3,200 public egress charge we didn't anticipate. Also starting renewal talks with LedgerBridge; looking to negotiate credits and a dedicated connector pilot. tagging @dave_procure @sara_eng to triage.

dave_procure: Can you paste the invoice line? I'll ask LedgerBridge for line-item detail and possible one-time credit. Also what's our renewal window?

rachel_fin: Quick paste from invoice: "INV-2024-234: Total $42,350 — Network egress (public): $3,200" Renewal auto-renews 2024-12-15 unless we send notice.

billingbot: Invoice INV-2024-234 posted 2024-10-05. Due date 2024-11-04. Payment terms: Net-30.

sara_eng: We did enable raw audit log export around Sep 12 for the invoice-enrich job — that could have bumped egress. If we can switch exports to our internal S3 via VPC endpoint it should remove public egress. Also the dedicated connector would help with latency for enrichment.

alex_ledgerbridge: Hi all — Alex from LedgerBridge here. Sorry for the surprise charge. By default our export pipeline routes over public network unless the account is configured for VPC-to-S3. We can: 1) apply a one-time migration credit for the $3,200, 2) add a 12-month committer discount (10%) if you commit to reserved throughput, and 3) include a 90-day egress cap during migration. I can send a formal SOW. Link to draft: https://ledgerbridge.example.com/sow/RW-2024 (internal link)

rachel_fin: Migration credit + 12mo commit sounds reasonable if the SOW includes firm cap on egress during migration. Maria — any legal concerns with 12mo?

maria_legal: 12mo is OK from our side if we get SLA & termination redlines. Need to add: (a) explicit egress responsibility clause, (b) 30-day cure period for downtime > SLA, (c) data portability clause. I can draft redlines once we get the SOW.

alex_ledgerbridge: Understood. We'll add the egress cap and the redline-ready SOW. Also clarifying pricing: embeddings SKU = $0.00085/embedding-token, text-gen = $0.0009/1k tokens, dedicated connector monthly fee = $2,500 (waived first month under pilot). I'll include these line items.

dave_procure: Can we get the 90-day egress cap in writing plus a ramp schedule? i.e., Month 1 cap $1k, Month 2 $2k, Month 3 $3k then normal billing. Also need clear invoice format with per-SKU line items.

alex_ledgerbridge: Yep — proposed ramp: $1,000 / $2,000 / $3,000 for first 90 days. We'll update invoice template to show SKU-level breakdown and include a migration credit line.

sara_eng: One technical ask before committing: will the dedicated connector support streaming export with backpressure? Our pipeline can't tolerate uncontrolled bursts.

alex_ledgerbridge: Yes — connector supports streaming + backpressure and you can configure max outstanding bytes. Example config snippet:
```json
{
  "connector": "s3-vpc",
  "streaming": true,
  "max_outstanding_bytes": 104857600,
  "retry_policy": {"max_retries": 5, "base_delay_ms": 200}
}
```

rachel_fin: Okay — if LedgerBridge sends an updated SOW with the migration credit, ramped egress cap, waived first-month connector fee, and line-item invoice format, finance is tentatively ok. Will approve payment after credit is applied to INV-2024-234.

dave_procure: I'll request the updated SOW and run it through procurement for PO. Target: get final offer and PO by EOD tomorrow.

alex_ledgerbridge: I'll have the revised SOW out within 6 business hours. Thanks — Alex.

maria_legal: Once SOW is in, I'll push redlines and try to keep it to a single review.

dave_procure: noted. If we need exec sign-off I'll loop in Tom.

rachel_fin: Thanks everyone — tagging this thread for follow-up. :thumbsup:
